model: SpaceLogic SLP Series humidity and temperature sensor (BACnet MS/TP)
applies_to: Schneider Electric SpaceLogic SLP Series wall humidity/temperature sensors (with or without touchscreen) set to BACnet MS/TP.
summary: The SpaceLogic SLP humidity/temperature sensor reports room temperature and humidity over BACnet MS/TP (or Modbus). It has the same object layout as the Veris HW2 plus two writable offset values for the temperature and humidity readings.
notes: Names with * are preserved through power outages; avoid writing them cyclically.
Touchscreen setpoint, fan speed, display and color objects only matter on touchscreen models.
Same object set as the Veris HW2 Protocol Series sensor plus AV 7/AV 8 offsets.
Source: SpaceLogic SLP Series Humidity and Temperature Sensors installation instructions Z207903-0J (June 2024).

source.title: SpaceLogic Sensors, SLP Series Humidity and Temperature Sensors - BACnet and Modbus Installation Instructions

integration.summary: Set the MS/TP address and BACnet mode on the DIP switches, then read room temperature and humidity; use AV 7/AV 8 to trim the readings once.

minimum_points.name: Occupancy Override
minimum_points.why: Override button state: active = not occupied

setup: BACnet MS/TP on RS-485: DIP switch ADDRESS positions 1-7 set the MAC (0-127 for BACnet), position 8 selects BACnet or Modbus.
Baud rates for BACnet: 9600, 19200, 38400, 76800, set on the CONFIG DIP switch.
Device instance = Vendor_ID followed by the MS/TP address (e.g. 133nnn); it can be rewritten in the device object.
gotchas: Occupancy Override logic is inverted: active means not occupied.
Offsets (AV 7/AV 8) are preserved settings; write them once.

points.name: Temperature Offset*
points.description: Offset added to temperature reading, -5 to 5

points.name: Humidity Offset*
points.description: Offset added to humidity reading, -10 to 10

points.name: Select Temperature Display*
points.description: Main screen shows setpoint (active) or room temperature
points.states: 0=Room temp on main screen, 1=Setpoint on main screen

points.name: Display Setpoint*
points.description: Shows temperature setpoint on home screen
